notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI's create screen is a deliberate port of benilla's char_create (the file cites CreateSelection/reset/clamp/cycle_dial/randomize, the result-code table with CHAR_CREATE_SUCCESS=0x2E, the name rules): per-race class lists from CharBaseInfo, dial ranges from CharSections/CharHairGeosets/CharacterFacialHairStyles, the byte-exact CMSG_CHAR_CREATE wire, GlueStrings faction/race/class paragraphs, starting outfit on the 3D preview, drag-to-rotate, and success re-enum with the new row armed. The wire is fully covered (3/3 opcodes).
